name: Ribeira Sacra
terms: Denominación de Origen, Spain's main quality tier.
Young wine, sold with little or no aging. Some see a few months in oak.

blurb.text: A Galician DO in Lugo and Ourense provinces. Vineyards sit on steep slopes in the Miño and Sil river valleys. The region is known for red wines, and Mencía and Godello are among the allowed grapes.
